request.intent: For a lossless coherent optical network, calculate the output probabilities. There is one input photon but its input mode has not been specified: it may be mode 0 or mode 1, and I do not authorize choosing either. R(t) = [[cos(t), -sin(t)], [sin(t), cos(t)]]. Apply R(a), exp(i*phi) on mode 1, then R(b); use radians.
